author: mu-inbox
body: [watermelon-full-preview] Landed 2026-11-12 in 77f7d761 (tip 323fcc6b). The chat delivery alarm now classifies a pane parked at a prompt as blocked-prompt and says in plain terms that the agent waits at a question or permission prompt in its TUI and how to answer it. Resolution no longer erases the warning: the warning text stays and the resolved line is appended naming when the hold began and how long it lasted. Tests cover post/rewrite/resolved preservation and the blocked wording.
